final: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.riskeval AS riskeval, sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin AS ratio FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), grp AS (SELECT riskeval, AVG(ratio) AS group_avg FROM joined GROUP BY riskeval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM grp) SELECT AVG(g.group_avg) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(g.group_avg - o.overall_avg) AS avg_group_minus_overall FROM grp g JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE g.group_avg > o.overall_avg
